harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 24.04), installed rootless podman, created the unprivileged appsvc user, enabled systemd lingering for it, and deployed an nginx:alpine container as an appsvc systemd --user service (webapp.service) publishing port 8080. Verified it serves HTTP 200 with no active login session for appsvc. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, rebooted node1 natively, confirmed the boot ID changed, and confirmed the containerized app auto-recovered and continued serving port 8080 without any login session for appsvc.
actions_performed: Installed podman, uidmap, slirp4netns, fuse-overlayfs via apt on node1
Created unprivileged user appsvc (uid 1000) with valid subuid/subgid ranges for rootless containers
Enabled systemd lingering for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger) so user services run without an active login session
Wrote and enabled a systemd --user unit (webapp.service) under appsvc that runs 'podman run -p 8080:80 nginx:alpine'
Pre-pulled the nginx:alpine image as appsvc and started/enabled the service; verified HTTP 200 on $NODE_IP:8080 with no appsvc login session active
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, service enabled/active state, absence of appsvc login session, and working curl response
Issued a native, acknowledged-before-disconnect reboot of node1 via systemd-run + systemctl reboot
Polled node1 until exec was available again and confirmed the boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified post-restart recovery: webapp.service enabled and active, container running, no appsvc login session, HTTP 200 on port 8080

evidence.requirement: Container web app runs as unprivileged appsvc user on port 8080
evidence.summary: appsvc user created (uid 1000, non-root); podman container 'webapp' (nginx:alpine) running via systemd --user unit; curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 with nginx welcome page

evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
evidence.summary: loginctl enable-linger appsvc set Linger=yes; webapp.service is systemctl --user enabled; loginctl list-sessions shows no session for appsvc while service is active
Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a, webapp.service enabled+active, no appsvc login session, and HTTP 200 curl response before restart
systemd-run --no-block scheduled 'systemctl reboot' 1s in the future so the exec call returned its acknowledgement before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node actually restarted (mid-restart unreachable, then changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node was unreachable (connection timed out) during reboot, then became reachable again with boot_id changed to c8807e90-ca21-4422-9623-6916db9c6b15, proving a real restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of service, data/container, and no-login-session requirement
evidence.summary: After restart: boot_id confirmed new, webapp.service enabled+active, podman container 'webapp' running fresh (new container ID), no appsvc login session, and curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 with nginx page
